title: Sign-out invalidates the project session; realm end-session is a per-record option
asA: operator who has signed in through the project's Keycloak-backed sign-in surface
iWant: a sign-out request to clear my project session server-side and, when the realm record declares it, redirect to the realm's end-session endpoint
soThat: the next request from this browser is unauthenticated regardless of what the realm still holds

acceptanceCriteria.description: A POST to the sign-out route invalidates the session handle server-side and clears the session cookie in the browser.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a session issued from US-11101 (opaque-handle mode) and a project route at `POST /auth/sign-out` wired to the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.when: the browser dispatches the sign-out request
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response clears the session cookie (`Set-Cookie` with the cookie name, empty value, `Max-Age=0`, `HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Lax`); the session-record store no longer holds a record for the pre-signout session handle; the next protected-route request replaying the pre-signout cookie value is refused as unauthenticated

acceptanceCriteria.description: When a realm record sets `providerLogout: 'redirect'` and discovery has `end_session_endpoint`, sign-out returns a 302 to that endpoint.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a realm record whose declaration sets `providerLogout: 'redirect'`, a discovery response carrying `end_session_endpoint`, and a session issued against that realm
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response status is 302; the `Location` header equals the discovered `end_session_endpoint` with the configured `post_logout_redirect_uri` and, when the id_token is available on the session record, the `id_token_hint` query parameter carrying the raw id_token; the session cookie is cleared on the same response; the session record is deleted

acceptanceCriteria.description: A realm record with `providerLogout: 'redirect'` whose discovery response omits `end_session_endpoint` refuses boot with `KEYCLOAK_LOGOUT_NOT_DECLARED`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a realm-config record whose `providerLogout` is `'redirect'` pointed at a discovery document that lacks the `end_session_endpoint` field
acceptanceCriteria.when: the discovery client's boot fetch completes
acceptanceCriteria.then: the process terminates with error code `KEYCLOAK_LOGOUT_NOT_DECLARED` naming the realm slug; no listener is left running; the audit log records one `keycloak.discovery_refused` event carrying realmSlug and reason class `logout-endpoint-missing`
